parole.significato: A small circular or oblong boat made of wickerwork and made watertight with hides or pitch, propelled and steered with…
parole.testo: Of Celtic origin; related to Welsh corwg, Irish curach (“boat”) and Cornish gorhel (“ship”), from Proto-Celtic *kurukos (“boat”).

parole.motivo_incerta: Of uncertain origin; Possibly; modello unc/uncertain
parole.significato: A shackle or fetter, especially for the leg.
parole.testo: From Middle English *give, *gyve (found only in plural gives, gyves (“shackles; fetters”)). Of uncertain origin, possibly from low dialect taking from Celtic; compare Welsh gefyn (“fetter, shackle”), Irish geibbionn (“fetters”), geimheal (“fetter, chain, shackle”); these are from Proto-Celtic *gem-
